hook_text: The very first bicycle had no pedals, and the very first car had only three wheels.
clip_script: 1817: a man in a top hat pushes himself along on a wooden machine with two wheels and no pedals. 1886: a strange three-wheeled car puffs and rattles down a road in Germany. And in between, a huge black steam engine roars out of a cloud of smoke, pulling a long line of carriages. Bicycles, cars and trains. Three inventions that changed the way people move on land forever.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline: a running machine, a penny-farthing, a safety bicycle, a steam locomotive with smoke, and a three-wheeled car, each with its year.
mood: Inventive and exciting, like a workshop full of new ideas.
pacing: Quick reveal of each invention with its date, building to the big finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look closely at how the chain on a bicycle works.
